caption: The drawing features five distinct fruit illustrations arranged around a central decorative plate. The plate is white with a detailed, interwoven openwork rim patterned with heart-shaped and leaf motifs, and it displays a design of two purple plums with green and brown leaves in the center. Surrounding the plate are illustrations of different fruits: at the top left is a red pear with green and yellow leaves; at the top right is a yellow and red peach with green and yellow leaves; at the bottom left is a red plum with green and yellow leaves; and at the bottom right is an orange and yellow peach with green and yellow leaves. All fruits are accompanied by stems and leaves, and each illustration is labeled with text indicating its placement on a plate. The background is an off-white or cream color, and the overall composition arranges the fruits symmetrically around the central plate.
title: Plates
